statusDetail: Coverage-complete audit across six representative paths. The legal age-verification step was inspected but not completed with personal identity.

page.notes: id.xhamster.com localized Indonesian media site; location-sensitive UI presented UK age-verification messaging. Home/category/detail/account/404 templates covered. Not covered: authenticated account area, actual identity verification, payment/subscription completion, creator upload, live chat, or media playback beyond the age gate.

checkOutcomes.method: Agent judgement using dark.png and representative-path inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: The page is permanently dark but declares computed color-scheme: normal and contains no authored preference-driven theme; dark emulation produces the same fixed palette rather than honoring the system choice.

checkOutcomes.method: Agent judgement using reduced-motion.json and representative-path inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: With prefers-reduced-motion: reduce active, the probe still found eight running animations of 2000 ms and no matching reduced-motion CSS rule.

checkOutcomes.method: Agent judgement using lighthouse.json and representative-path inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse reports failed color-contrast and link-in-text-block audits; high-contrast emulation does not expose an authored forced-colors/prefers-contrast treatment.

checkOutcomes.method: Agent judgement using page-probe.json and representative-path inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: Rendered CSS inspection found no authored view-transition rules; navigation among the MPA home, category, signup and detail routes uses abrupt document swaps.

checkOutcomes.method: Agent judgement using page-probe.json and representative-path inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: No parallax, scrollytelling, reveal-on-scroll, or other scroll-linked effect was observed on the representative routes.
checkOutcomes.reason: The audited routes do not use a scroll-linked motion effect, so there is no scroll handler or animation timeline to assess.

checkOutcomes.method: Agent judgement using page-probe.json and representative-path inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: Browsing uses native document scrolling and real anchors; no custom pointermove gesture layer that fights scrolling was found.

checkOutcomes.method: Agent judgement using mobile.png and representative-path inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: The long home and category pages retain a large static header/sidebar; CSS inspection found no scroll-state container query or scroll progress treatment.

checkOutcomes.method: Agent judgement using page-probe.json and representative-path inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: No tooltip, contextual popover, or edge-positioned menu was opened or present on the representative paths.
checkOutcomes.reason: No anchored overlay use case was present in the tested states.

checkOutcomes.method: Agent judgement using category-mobile.png and representative-path inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: Descriptive headings, real links, the persistent category navigation, and clear detail-page title preserve location and direct attention across tested routes.

checkOutcomes.method: Agent judgement using desktop.png and representative-path inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: The initial desktop screenshot is dominated by a cookie overlay that obscures the content grid before interaction.

checkOutcomes.method: Agent judgement using signup-email-probe.json and representative-path inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: The signup modal is an ad-hoc div with role=dialog rather than a native dialog, and the cookie overlay appears without dialog/popover semantics in the captured DOM state.

checkOutcomes.method: Agent judgement using mobile.png and representative-path inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: At 360 px, the fixed 180 px sidebar, desktop header, and age-verification banner consume most of the visible viewport while content is clipped to the right.

checkOutcomes.method: Agent judgement using layout-mobile.json and representative-path inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: The mobile layout primitive measured scrollWidth 1036 px against a 360 px visual viewport, 676 px overflow; screenshots show content and signup dialog clipped off-screen.

checkOutcomes.method: Agent judgement using signup-mobile.png and representative-path inspection

checkOutcomes.method: Agent judgement using focus-targets.json and representative-path inspection

checkOutcomes.method: Agent judgement using video-detail-mobile.png and representative-path inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: Home, category, signup and video-detail pages have descriptive titles and prominent primary content/actions; the first content grid and video title make purpose clear despite layout defects.

checkOutcomes.method: Agent judgement using video-detail-mobile.png and representative-path inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: The tested browse flow reached home, category listing, a video detail page, and the clearly explained age-verification start state without a dead end; account creation exposed Google, X, and email routes.

checkOutcomes.method: Agent judgement using not-found-probe.json and representative-path inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: A deliberately invalid route rendered a localized “Halaman tidak ditemukan” state with a home recovery link and popular-content alternatives instead of a blank shell.

checkOutcomes.method: Agent judgement using lighthouse.json and representative-path inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: Desktop trace LCP was 1.10 s and CLS 0.0049, but Lighthouse mobile LCP was 3.9 s, outside the good <=2.5 s threshold; TBT was 95 ms.

checkOutcomes.method: Agent judgement using layout-desktop.json and representative-path inspection

checkOutcomes.method: Agent judgement using load-trace-summary.json and representative-path inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: The trace recorded two long tasks, 133.83 ms longest and 95.23 ms total blocking time; this is bounded and below the 200 ms Lighthouse good TBT range.

checkOutcomes.evidence: HAR captured 144 requests and 1.70 MB transferred, including 11 stylesheets, parser-blocking stylesheet candidates and one uncompressed 9.8 KB text response.

checkOutcomes.method: Agent judgement using lighthouse.json and representative-path inspection

checkOutcomes.method: Agent judgement using signup-mobile.png and representative-path inspection

checkOutcomes.method: Agent judgement using layout-mobile.json and representative-path inspection

checkOutcomes.method: Agent judgement using lighthouse.json and representative-path inspection

checkOutcomes.method: Agent judgement using page-probe.json and representative-path inspection

checkOutcomes.method: Agent judgement using layout-mobile.json and representative-path inspection

checkOutcomes.method: Agent judgement using crawl-probe.json and representative-path inspection

checkOutcomes.method: Agent judgement using video-detail-probe.json and representative-path inspection

checkOutcomes.method: Agent judgement using signup-email-probe.json and representative-path inspection

checkOutcomes.method: Agent judgement using headers.json and representative-path inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: HSTS and clickjacking controls are present, but X-Content-Type-Options and Referrer-Policy are absent; Permissions-Policy only covers two client-hint features and CSP lacks script restrictions.

checkOutcomes.method: Agent judgement using discoverability.json and representative-path inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: Discoverability comparison found 86% rendered-word coverage in raw HTML, with title, h1 and description present and no empty JS shell.

checkOutcomes.method: Agent judgement using signup-mobile.png and representative-path inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: The signup dialog and content grid are positioned on a 1036 px desktop canvas and are visibly cut off at the 360 px viewport edge.

checkOutcomes.method: Agent judgement using pwa-probe.json and representative-path inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: The page links a manifest with icons/start_url, has an active service worker, and exposes an xh-offline-cache cache.

checkOutcomes.method: Agent judgement using not-found-probe.json and representative-path inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: A missing route renders a localized recovery explanation, a home link, and useful alternative content rather than a blank or infinite loading state.

checkOutcomes.method: Agent judgement using page-probe.json and representative-path inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: The Indonesian experience declares html lang=id and presents a broad localized-language selector; tested text direction is correctly LTR for Indonesian.

checkOutcomes.method: Agent judgement using page-probe.json and representative-path inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: No date, currency, duration formatting, or locale-sensitive numeric input was present in the representative public states.
checkOutcomes.reason: The tested states did not expose locale-sensitive data that could be meaningfully checked.

checkOutcomes.method: Agent judgement using page-probe.json and representative-path inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: No scheduled event, stored timestamp, recurring interval, or cross-time-zone workflow was present.
checkOutcomes.reason: The representative routes contain no time-zone-sensitive task.

checkOutcomes.method: Agent judgement using desktop.png and representative-path inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: The initial consent overlay blocks content, while the persistent banner asks Indonesian users to verify age “according to UK law”; this jurisdiction/context mismatch can mislead users about why verification is required.

checkOutcomes.method: Agent judgement using signup-email-probe.json and representative-path inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: The signup email state contains duplicate email inputs, no associated email label, required=false, and a placeholder-only required cue; errors cannot be announced reliably from this markup.

checkOutcomes.method: Agent judgement using signup-email-probe.json and representative-path inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: The signup email input explicitly uses autocomplete=off; the password uses new-password correctly, but the email field suppresses standard autofill assistance.

checkOutcomes.method: Agent judgement using signup-mobile.png and representative-path inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: The signup disclosure states personal data will be public and shared for partner services, yet the flow offers password/social login without a passkey and the mobile dialog is clipped, making commitments hard to review.

checkOutcomes.method: Agent judgement using images.json and representative-path inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: Image audit found 12 oversized images, 16 legacy-format results, 29 missing dimensions and three without responsive srcset.

checkOutcomes.method: Agent judgement using network-summary.json and representative-path inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: The home load performs 144 requests and starts recommendation, advertising, identity and analytics work before related user intent; eight animations remain running.

checkOutcomes.method: Agent judgement using network-summary.json and representative-path inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: Third parties account for 117 requests and 1.59 MB of the 1.70 MB transfer, while Google identity is loaded on the browsing homepage before signup.

checkOutcomes.method: Agent judgement using page-probe.json and representative-path inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: No WebMCP or agent-facing tool registration is exposed.
checkOutcomes.reason: This public media-browsing surface does not declare an agent-facing capability, and the emerging principle allows absence without penalty.

checkOutcomes.method: Agent judgement using page-probe.json and representative-path inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: No on-device language-model or summarizer use case is present in the tested browsing and account states.
checkOutcomes.reason: No user task on the representative routes requires on-device inference.

checkOutcomes.method: Agent judgement using heap-baseline.heapsnapshot and representative-path inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: The baseline V8 heap summary contains 683,189 heap nodes, 3.20 million edges and 36.6 MB self size for a listing page before media playback.

checkOutcomes.method: Agent judgement using heap-post-scroll.heapsnapshot and representative-path inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: Neither heap summary listed Detached* constructors among the largest retained groups; the observed growth is reported separately, but direct detached-DOM evidence was not found.

paths.description: Localized home/listing template and initial consent state.
Home/listing template at a 360x800 visual viewport.
Primary account creation modal and email step.
Representative media detail and legal age-verification state.

findings.summary: The site renders a desktop canvas on mobile
findings.evidence: The mobile layout primitive measured scrollWidth 1036 px against a 360 px visual viewport, 676 px overflow; screenshots show content and signup dialog clipped off-screen.
findings.suggestedFix: Use width=device-width without forced desktop layout, fluid intrinsic sizing, and responsive navigation so scrollWidth never exceeds the viewport.

findings.summary: Zoom/reflow and target sizing fail the mobile accessibility bar
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed meta-viewport and target-size audits; the 360 px screenshots demonstrate failed reflow with 676 px horizontal overflow.
findings.suggestedFix: Allow user scaling, eliminate fixed-width overflow, and enlarge undersized controls.

findings.summary: Contrast and high-contrast support are incomplete
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports failed color-contrast and link-in-text-block audits; high-contrast emulation does not expose an authored forced-colors/prefers-contrast treatment.
findings.suggestedFix: Meet WCAG contrast ratios and add forced-colors/prefers-contrast treatments for essential controls and links.

findings.summary: Cookie consent obscures core content on load
findings.evidence: The initial desktop screenshot is dominated by a cookie overlay that obscures the content grid before interaction.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a compact, non-blocking consent surface where legally possible, preserve equal accept/reject controls, and keep content visible.

findings.summary: Desktop chrome overwhelms mobile content
findings.evidence: At 360 px, the fixed 180 px sidebar, desktop header, and age-verification banner consume most of the visible viewport while content is clipped to the right.
findings.suggestedFix: Collapse navigation into mobile-appropriate controls and prioritize the content column at narrow widths.

findings.summary: Components do not adapt to their available space
findings.evidence: CSS inspection found no @container rules, and the same sidebar, grid, and modal retain desktop dimensions in the 360 px captures.
findings.suggestedFix: Introduce container-query breakpoints for the grid, sidebar, header, and modal, with intrinsic fallback sizing.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus and touch targets are inadequate
findings.evidence: The focus probe found focused inputs/buttons with outline-style none; Lighthouse also failed target-size, and many navigation targets are only 30–32 px tall.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide a visible :focus-visible indicator and increase interactive target size/spacing toward 44 CSS px.

findings.summary: Mobile LCP misses the good threshold
findings.evidence: Desktop trace LCP was 1.10 s and CLS 0.0049, but Lighthouse mobile LCP was 3.9 s, outside the good <=2.5 s threshold; TBT was 95 ms.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritize the mobile LCP resource and reduce startup script/style contention; verify LCP <=2.5 s on representative mobile hardware.

findings.summary: Startup JavaScript is disproportionately heavy
findings.evidence: The initial page shipped 62 scripts totaling about 1.00 MB; the largest index bundle alone transferred 400 KB and Google sign-in loaded 98 KB before signup intent.
findings.suggestedFix: Code-split page features and defer Google identity, player, and modal code until the corresponding user intent.

findings.summary: Controls and structure have accessibility naming failures
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed button-name, label-content-name-mismatch, list semantics, and accessibility-tree audits; the email step also exposes duplicate email inputs without programmatic labels.
findings.suggestedFix: Give every control a matching accessible name, associate visible labels, remove duplicate hidden inputs from the accessibility tree, and repair list semantics.

findings.summary: Text and links fail contrast requirements
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed color-contrast and link-in-text-block checks on the audited home page.
findings.suggestedFix: Adjust foreground/background tokens to WCAG AA and do not rely on color alone to distinguish links.

findings.summary: Focus visibility and heading structure are unreliable
findings.evidence: The focus walk shows focused search, login, and other buttons with no outline; signup starts at h3 without a page h1 and Lighthouse reports malformed accessibility structure.
findings.suggestedFix: Restore strong :focus-visible styles, make heading levels logical, and manage focus into and out of the modal.

findings.summary: Clipping makes text unreadable on mobile
findings.evidence: At 360 px, headings, dialog copy and media controls are clipped beyond the viewport, preventing complete reading even though font sizes themselves are reasonable.
findings.suggestedFix: Reflow text and dialog content inside the visual viewport with fluid widths and wrapping.

findings.summary: Mobile indexing receives a non-mobile layout
findings.evidence: Links use real hrefs and robots permits public content, but the page is not mobile-friendly: 676 px overflow at a 360 px viewport and Lighthouse flags viewport configuration.
findings.suggestedFix: Correct viewport/reflow behavior and retain crawlable anchors so mobile crawlers and users receive the same usable layout.

findings.summary: Cookie and CSP defenses are incomplete
findings.evidence: HTTPS and HSTS are present, but CSP is limited to frame-ancestors; x_csrf_token and settings cookies lack Secure, and settings uses SameSite=None.
findings.suggestedFix: Set Secure on all HTTPS cookies, avoid SameSite=None unless necessary, and deploy a nonce/hash-based CSP beyond frame-ancestors.

findings.summary: Third-party collection dominates initial load
findings.evidence: The load contacted 13 third-party origins; 117 requests and 1.59 MB were classified third-party, including collector and advertising/recommendation endpoints before explicit intent.
findings.suggestedFix: Gate optional identity, advertising, recommendation, and analytics calls on context/consent; batch and minimize telemetry.

findings.summary: Several browser-enforced defenses are missing
findings.evidence: HSTS and clickjacking controls are present, but X-Content-Type-Options and Referrer-Policy are absent; Permissions-Policy only covers two client-hint features and CSP lacks script restrictions.
findings.suggestedFix: Add nosniff, a strict Referrer-Policy, a deny-by-default Permissions-Policy, and a substantive CSP with Trusted Types where feasible.

findings.summary: Critical modal UI is cut off at narrow widths
findings.evidence: The signup dialog and content grid are positioned on a 1036 px desktop canvas and are visibly cut off at the 360 px viewport edge.
findings.suggestedFix: Constrain top-layer UI to the visual viewport and provide responsive fallback positions/sizing.

findings.summary: Signup field semantics undermine humane validation
findings.evidence: The signup email state contains duplicate email inputs, no associated email label, required=false, and a placeholder-only required cue; errors cannot be announced reliably from this markup.
findings.suggestedFix: Use one labeled required email control, validate after interaction, set aria-invalid when needed, and announce a specific recovery message.

findings.summary: Account commitments are difficult to review safely on mobile
findings.evidence: The signup disclosure states personal data will be public and shared for partner services, yet the flow offers password/social login without a passkey and the mobile dialog is clipped, making commitments hard to review.
findings.suggestedFix: Make all account/data commitments fully readable before signup, provide passkeys, and keep cancellation/account controls easy to find.

findings.summary: Non-core work starts eagerly
findings.evidence: The home load performs 144 requests and starts recommendation, advertising, identity and analytics work before related user intent; eight animations remain running.
findings.suggestedFix: Defer identity, ad, recommendation and analytics work until consent/intent, batch events, and stop non-visible animation.

findings.summary: Third-party cost is disproportionate to first-view value
findings.evidence: Third parties account for 117 requests and 1.59 MB of the 1.70 MB transfer, while Google identity is loaded on the browsing homepage before signup.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a third-party budget, lazy-load identity/ads/media widgets, and cache/defer assets outside the initial viewport.

findings.summary: Theme is hard-coded instead of preference-driven
findings.evidence: The page is permanently dark but declares computed color-scheme: normal and contains no authored preference-driven theme; dark emulation produces the same fixed palette rather than honoring the system choice.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and use prefers-color-scheme or light-dark() so browser UI and page surfaces follow the user preference.

findings.summary: Animations continue under reduced-motion
findings.evidence: With prefers-reduced-motion: reduce active, the probe still found eight running animations of 2000 ms and no matching reduced-motion CSS rule.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a prefers-reduced-motion: reduce branch that removes non-essential animation and auto-advance.

findings.summary: Overlays rely on custom dialog construction
findings.evidence: The signup modal is an ad-hoc div with role=dialog rather than a native dialog, and the cookie overlay appears without dialog/popover semantics in the captured DOM state.
findings.suggestedFix: Use <dialog> for the modal flow and a suitable native popover/dialog primitive with reliable focus and dismiss behavior.

findings.summary: The critical delivery path is request-heavy
findings.evidence: HAR captured 144 requests and 1.70 MB transferred, including 11 stylesheets, parser-blocking stylesheet candidates and one uncompressed 9.8 KB text response.
findings.suggestedFix: Consolidate critical CSS, compress all text responses, preserve deferred scripts, and shorten the dependency chain for first content.

findings.summary: Image markup is incompletely sized and optimized
findings.evidence: The document has HTML doctype and UTF-8, but image inspection found 29 of 36 images without explicit dimensions, 12 oversized, and one missing alt.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit width/height or aspect-ratio for thumbnails, request correctly sized variants, and add meaningful alt where needed.

findings.summary: Sitemap and localization indexing signals are incomplete
findings.evidence: Canonical URLs are present, but /sitemap.xml returned 404 and localized routes expose zero hreflang links despite a large language selector.
findings.suggestedFix: Publish a sitemap index and reciprocal hreflang alternates for localized equivalents.

findings.summary: Rich entity and share metadata are incomplete
findings.evidence: The video detail provides Open Graph tags but no JSON-LD VideoObject; home and category provide neither Open Graph metadata nor structured entity data.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate VideoObject/BreadcrumbList JSON-LD and complete Open Graph/Twitter metadata that matches visible content.

findings.summary: Authentication lacks a phishing-resistant passkey option
findings.evidence: No permission prompt fired on load, but signup offers Google, X, email and password only; no WebAuthn/passkey capability was exposed on the tested account flow.
findings.suggestedFix: Offer passkey registration and sign-in alongside account recovery, requesting capabilities only after user intent.

findings.summary: Consent and age-verification context is confusing
findings.evidence: The initial consent overlay blocks content, while the persistent banner asks Indonesian users to verify age “according to UK law”; this jurisdiction/context mismatch can mislead users about why verification is required.
findings.suggestedFix: Use the user’s actual jurisdiction and explain the legal basis plainly; keep consent choices equally prominent without blocking unrelated browsing.

findings.summary: Signup disables email autofill
findings.evidence: The signup email input explicitly uses autocomplete=off; the password uses new-password correctly, but the email field suppresses standard autofill assistance.
findings.suggestedFix: Use autocomplete=email and keep autocomplete=new-password so password managers and assistive input can help.

findings.summary: Image delivery wastes bytes and layout metadata
findings.evidence: Image audit found 12 oversized images, 16 legacy-format results, 29 missing dimensions and three without responsive srcset.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve responsive AVIF/WebP variants sized near display dimensions and include dimensions/srcset.

findings.summary: Repeated scrolling retains additional page state
findings.evidence: After ten bottom/top scroll cycles, same-session metrics grew from 23.29 MB to 25.00 MB, DOM nodes from 1811 to 1936 and active animations from 8 to 12; separate heap summaries also grew by 1.05 MB and 19,427 nodes.
findings.suggestedFix: Profile the scroll/feed lifecycle, release thumbnail animation/listener state when items leave view, and verify a plateau across repeated cycles.

findings.summary: Baseline heap footprint is heavy for the initial listing
findings.evidence: The baseline V8 heap summary contains 683,189 heap nodes, 3.20 million edges and 36.6 MB self size for a listing page before media playback.
findings.suggestedFix: Virtualize/defer below-fold cards and lazy-initialize recommendation/player code to reduce the retained startup graph.

findings.summary: Route changes are abrupt
findings.evidence: Rendered CSS inspection found no authored view-transition rules; navigation among the MPA home, category, signup and detail routes uses abrupt document swaps.
findings.suggestedFix: Use same-origin cross-document View Transitions with a reduced-motion fallback for stable shared elements.

findings.summary: Long pages provide no scroll-aware navigation feedback
findings.evidence: The long home and category pages retain a large static header/sidebar; CSS inspection found no scroll-state container query or scroll progress treatment.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce persistent chrome on scroll and add a lightweight scroll-state/progress affordance where it aids orientation.
